archimate:Capability.name: Care Protocol Management
archimate:Capability.documentation:
Care Protocol Management is a strategic business capability that governs the creation, standardization, digital deployment, and maintenance of clinical guidelines and evidence-based pathways across a healthcare organization.
Its purpose is to reduce clinical variation and ensure high-quality patient outcomes by embedding standardized, up-to-date medical best practices directly into everyday clinical workflows.
Example: A hospital network uses this capability to establish a uniform, evidence-based sepsis treatment protocol that automatically triggers standard fluid volumes and antibiotic orders whenever a patient exhibits signs of systemic infection.
